methodology: Native URP renders: orthographic 180px and perspective 120px body height; four SpriteRenderer flipX/Y states. Separate ink and complete-paper alpha are compared with the unflipped render mirrored around the canvas center. Solid source cores from the built-in URP Sprite-Unlit shader must remain covered (1px raster tolerance). Legacy scout/medic reference cores exclude their baked light paper. No bases, shadows or gameplay scripts enter pixel measurements. This tests renderer fidelity, not approval of the anatomical proportions in an original drawing.
